title: DNA Extraction from Filters using QIAgen DNeasy and QIAshredder
author: Melissa B Duhaime
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jx5cpq6

steps.title: Prepare kit reagents
steps.instruction: Add 25 mL ethanol to Buffer AW1 and check the bottle box (✔); add 30 mL ethanol to Buffer AW2 and check the bottle box (✔). Confirm Buffers ATL and AL are fully dissolved and warm them to 56 °C if needed. Prepare a mixture of 100 µL Buffer ATL plus 30 µL Proteinase K per sample; if Proteinase K is powder, dissolve to 10 mg · mL⁻¹ in nuclease‑free water. Make only the volume required for the day's extractions.

steps.title: Set up bench and equipment
steps.instruction: Turn on a water bath or incubator and set to 56 °C. Wipe the bench surface with 70 % EtOH. Fill a beaker with 70 % EtOH and place forceps in it for flame sterilization. Position a Bunsen burner nearby. Retrieve filter samples from the freezer and thaw on ice, handling no more than six filters or sixteen plastic pieces at a time.

steps.title: Label tubes and add ATL/Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Label a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube for each sample. Add 130 µL of the prepared ATL + Proteinase K solution to each tube.

steps.title: Transfer and size filter into tube
steps.instruction: Flame‑sterilize forceps and a blade over the Bunsen burner, then cool on a Kimwipe. Using two sterilized forceps, pull the filter out of its vial, place it on the inside of a plate lid, and cut to the desired size with the sterile blade; return unwanted portions to the vial. Fold the desired filter piece in half with the sample side inward, unfold, and transfer the filter into the labeled 1.5 mL tube. Discard the empty vial and wipe the bench between samples.

steps.title: Lyse filter with ATL and AL
steps.instruction: Once all filters are in the ATL solution, vortex each tube for 10 seconds. Add 300 µL Buffer AL to each tube and vortex for another 10 seconds. Incubate the tubes for 60 minutes at 56 °C, vortexing briefly every 15 minutes (or place in a rotating incubator). During this incubation, label the tops and sides of the QIAshredder and DNeasy columns, and label one 1.5 mL Lo‑Bind tube with the extraction number and another 1.5 mL Lo‑Bind tube with the sample ID stickers. After incubation, vortex the tubes at maximum speed for 10 minutes, then vortex for 30 seconds at 20 000 × g using a multi‑tube adapter.

steps.title: Homogenize lysate with QIAshredder
steps.instruction: Flame‑sterilize forceps again, then pipette as much lysate as possible into a QIAshredder (purple) column together with the filter or plastic piece. Centrifuge the column for 15 seconds at 20 000 × g.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL 100 % ethanol to the flow‑through from the QIAshredder and vortex to mix (clip the purple cap onto the tube while vortexing). Transfer 700 µL of the lysate‑ethanol mixture onto a DNA Mini Spin (clear) column and centrifuge for 15 seconds at 20 000 × g. Discard the flow‑through (do not bleach). Repeat the transfer and centrifugation until all lysate‑ethanol mixture has passed through the column, then discard the final flow‑through and collection tube. Place the column into a new, labeled 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW1 to the DNA Mini Spin column, centrifuge for 15 seconds at 20 000 × g, and discard the flow‑through (not compatible with bleach).

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW2 to the column, centrifuge for 2 minutes at 20 000 × g, then discard the flow‑through and spin again for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute DNA – first elution
steps.instruction: Place the DNA Mini Spin column in a clean, labeled 1.5 mL tube (extraction number). Add 50 µL Buffer AE directly onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes, then centrifuge for 1 minute at ≥8 000 × g. This eluate is "Elution #1".

steps.title: Elute DNA – second elution and storage
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new, labeled 1.5 mL tube marked "Elution #2". Add another 50 µL Buffer AE onto the membrane and centrifuge for 1 minute at ≥8 000 × g to collect "Elution #2". Store both eluates at 4 °C; for long‑term storage, aliquot what is needed for the fridge and keep the remainder at –20 °C or –80 °C.
